description: This is a shell script for testing git remote helper commands, including clone, fetch, push, and various edge cases. It includes setup commands, tests for repository operations, and failure case checks.

methods.name: compare_refs
methods.description: Compares two git references or commits in different repositories, verifying their equality or specific conditions based on parameters.

methods.name: clean_mark
methods.description: Removes mark files from git's object database and sorts them, used for cleanup and verification in tests.
